   - Conflict rows: vermillion (#D55E00), solid circle marker, size=8
   - XNLI rows: blue (#0072B2), solid circle marker, size=8

   - The substantial CI overlap between Conflict and XNLI rows within each model group is THE key message
   - Consider adding light vertical shaded regions or connecting brackets to emphasize overlap (optional, only if clean)

    caption: "Confound exclusion results."
    placement: experiments

    columns: [Control, Model, Metric, Value, "p-value"]

literature_strategy:
  citation_budget: 30
  macro_context:
    - "knowledge conflict in LLMs"
    - "cross-lingual representations in multilingual models"
    - "probing and mechanistic interpretability"
    - "representation steering and causal intervention"
  micro_clusters:
    - cluster_name: "Knowledge Conflict Detection"
      search_queries:
        - "knowledge conflict detection LLM probing residual stream 2024 2025 2026"
        - "context-parametric conflict resolution language model"
        - "ConflictQA dataset knowledge conflict"
      must_cite:
        - "ConflictQA (Xie et al. 2024)"
        - "zhao2024analysing (residual stream conflict probing)"
        - "boer2026probing (knowledge attribution probing)"
        - "pham2026where (intra-memory conflict mechanism)"
      target_count: 6

    - cluster_name: "Cross-lingual Conflict"
      search_queries:
        - "cross-lingual knowledge conflict multilingual LLM 2025 2026"
        - "CLEAR benchmark multilingual conflict evaluation"
      must_cite:
        - "zhao2026when (CLEAR)"
      target_count: 3

    - cluster_name: "Cross-lingual Representations"
      search_queries:
        - "cross-lingual representation alignment multilingual transformer layers 2024 2025"
        - "language-independent concept space multilingual LLM"
        - "English-centric bias multilingual model representations"
      must_cite:
        - "wang2025lost (Lost in Multilinguality)"
        - "Conneau et al. 2020 (cross-lingual alignment)"
      target_count: 5

    - cluster_name: "Probing Methodology"
      search_queries:
        - "probing classifier representations survey 2022 2024"
        - "linear probe limitations expressiveness"
      must_cite:
        - "Belinkov 2022 (probing survey)"
      target_count: 4

    - cluster_name: "Steering & Causal Intervention"
      search_queries:
        - "representation steering LLM causal intervention 2025 2026"
        - "activation steering knowledge conflict"
        - "probe direction steering residual stream"
      must_cite:
        - "zhao2025steering (SpARE)"
        - "basu2026interpretability (interpretability without actionability)"
        - "Li et al. 2024 (inference-time intervention)"
      target_count: 5

    - cluster_name: "Datasets & Evaluation Tools"
      search_queries:
        - "COMET translation evaluation metric"
        - "XNLI cross-lingual NLI benchmark"
      must_cite:
        - "XNLI (Conneau et al. 2018)"
        - "COMET (Rei et al. 2020 or 2022)"
      target_count: 4

writing_order:
  - experiments
  - method
  - introduction
  - related_work
  - discussion
  - abstract
  - conclusion
  - limitations
